svg.aria-label: Figure 9: The Build a team page
svg.title: Figure 9: The Build a team page
svg.text: Figure 9: The Build a team page
BuildTeam.razor. All four steps on one page: Team type, Team details, Hire (roles and draft roster) and Approve; the three dialogs it opens are below.
with Margot, your Chief of Staff
Huddle hires a manager and the roles around it. 26 types — you already run Data Team…
Team type grid: two rows, scrolls right; the Blank Team is first
The chosen card: tinted, check mark
A type you already run: “You have one” chip
Second row: more cards in the same grid; the rest scroll to the right
Team details section (once a type is chosen)
Keeps the garden planned, planted and watered…
Library folder: the same for every type; starts as the Teams folder, may be blank, must exist.
The folder icon opens the folder picker (B8b, below).
Step 2 is done once the name is free and the folder is allowed.
Reused by the Team page’s Members tab (M6, Figure 6): B9a, B9c and the save row; it adds the filter B9f/B9g under "Roles"
Roles grid: two rows, scrolls right
Order: Add card, the roles the template defines (green “Suggested”), your own roles, then the rest of the pool. Edit and Delete only on your own roles; ☑ = on the roster.
2 draft Agents · dashed ring = not hired yet
Two rows that fill down, then right; scrolls right
Plans, assigns and tracks development work…
Builds the assigned change and its tests…
each with a name and an avatar.
While the roster is empty this dashed box holds the space
Each card: an avatar drawn from the library
(a role’s suggested images first) in a dashed ring,
a drawn name, the role, a Manager badge for the
template’s manager, the model tier, and Re-roll
Approve section (once a type is chosen)
Off (hint: “Finish the team details first.” or “Add at least one Agent to the roster.”) until step 2 is
complete and the roster has an Agent. On: creates the Team, hires the roster, sets the manager, opens the Team.
A refused hire shows here; part-way failures add “Open team”.
Up one folder; type a path and press Enter; hidden and system
folders are left out; a drive root goes up to the list of drives.
Opened by the + card and by Edit on your own role. Saved to
custom-roles.json; Save is off until there is a title.
Persona body, Skills, Model, Effort, Work mode
The same card as a new Agent, started from the draft with its
avatar. Save draft changes only the roster card; nothing is created.
